items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I thought he was a fantastic musician when he first came from Texas.

ctx.x: You see. So I don't know if it was a conspiracy or not but they started writing oh man, we're tired of hearing this, these kind of records that all of them seem to sound the same and this and that, and this and that. So when the Freedom

come, oh this is the greatest thing I ever heard. It's different and it's more that, more vitality in it. It's got more of anything you want to call it see. Because they noticed the music was different. It was being detrimental to the guys that was doing it to themselves, you know. And so when the guy is doing this, is reading this, they get these big, like when the make these records like Ornette (Coleman)-- they get these five stars and stuff man.
